_doc: ART LANE: modern HD 2.5D (contemporary side-scroller). Rounded toy-like forms, soft ambient occlusion, smooth filtering — the non-pixel lane. This file IS the style guide — edit tokens/palette knobs to tune the lane; --graphics <this file> switches the whole game onto it.
